description: Use this when the user asks what is planned, being built or changing around an Australian suburb. Open government data for one published suburb: major projects that government registers list within 10 km (status, cost, timing, register link), new dwellings approved and estimated population for the ABS statistical area (SA2) it sits in, and its SA2, SA3 and SA4. Does not include prices, rents or yields.

suburb_id.description: The suburb id from find_suburb, for example "wollongong-nsw".

name: get_suburb_local_context
title: Local context for a suburb
